'''2019 European Championship Day 2 Stephan de Vos LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Stephan de Vos]] at [[2019 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Stephan de Vos]]
* '''Event:''' [[2019 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open TRM Vos LS 2019 EC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127141514/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-european-championships/ Internet Archive]
